headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of October 21, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 26.36% compared to SPY's 14.09%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 12.27%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved a remarkable return of 36.57%, driven by its strongest holding, PANW, which has returned 124.37%. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' has returned only 1.84%, with its bottom holding, ALB, showing a decline of 39.63%. This relative performance is particularly significant during periods of market uncertainty, as it highlights the portfolio's resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
